item.title: Tech Moves: Tableau CEO steps down; Microsoft taps new executive VPs; Avanade’s new CEO
item.description: Tableau CEO Ryan Aytay departs Salesforce after 19 years, hinting at a "new challenge" ahead. His exit follows other recent leadership departures at the company. Also, Microsoft names four new EVPs. And Avanade taps a new CEO. Read More

item.title: Washington’s ‘millionaires tax’ targets top earners as tech leaders warn of startup fallout
item.description: Washington leaders unveiled their so-called "millionaires tax" — a proposed 9.9% tax on personal income in excess of $1 million. Business leaders are worried about additional financial burdens in a shaky economy while supporters stress the growing affordability crisis. Read More

item.title: Amazon rolls out Alexa+ to all U.S. customers, making its AI assistant free for Prime members
item.description: Amazon is making Alexa+, its upgraded AI assistant, free for all U.S. Prime members starting today, including app and web-based chatbots. But with AI habits already ingrained around ChatGPT and other rivals, can Alexa+ catch up? Read More

item.title: Interlune digs into the development of an excavator for helium-3 and construction projects on the moon
item.description: Seattle startup takes a wider view of what it can do for NASA's Artemis moon program in the years ahead. Read More

item.title: Littlebird takes flight: Startup ships its wearable kid tracker, now with Amazon and Walmart ties
item.description: Founder and CEO Monica Plath has spent the last two years overhauling Littlebird’s technical DNA and its premise around screen-free technology suitable for schools. Read More

item.title: Microsoft exec Charlie Bell shifts to new role as Hayete Gallot returns from Google to lead security
item.description: A former Microsoft executive is returning to the company from Google to lead its security initiatives, replacing the former Amazon exec who is exiting the role to focus on engineering quality as an individual contributor at the Redmond company. Read More

item.title: Amazon earnings preview: Wall Street looks for cloud growth after capex surge and job cuts
item.description: Amazon reports Q4 earnings Thursday, capping a tech earnings season dominated by a single question: whether the industry's AI spending binge will ultimately be worth it. Here's what to watch. Read More

item.title: Jeff Bezos-owned Washington Post slashes hundreds of jobs — including newspaper’s Amazon reporter
item.description: Technology reporter Caroline O’Donovan, covered Amazon at the Post for almost four years and previously wrote an award-winning investigation at BuzzFeed into Amazon's delivery network. Read More

item.title: Smartsheet layoffs: Enterprise software giant cuts staff
item.description: The layoffs come amid a wave of recent cutbacks at Seattle-area tech companies. Read More

item.title: Amazon names Amit Agarwal to lead seller services as Dharmesh Mehta becomes Andy Jassy’s new TA
item.description: Amazon named a new executive leader for its Selling Partner Services business, one of the most consequential parts of the company, and said the division's current chief will become CEO Andy Jassy's next technical advisor. Read More
